title: StableRCA: Mechanism-Level Root Cause Analysis without Global Graph Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2606.05636v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Root-cause analysis (RCA) seeks to identify the true causal variables that are responsible for a system's abnormal behaviors. A central challenge in this task is to distinguish changes where the anomaly occurs from downstream propagated abnormal effects, particularly when the underlying causal structure is unknown. To address this challenge, we propose StableRCA, an RCA framework that helps distinguish root causes from variables affected by fault propagation by examining how each candidate's conditional distribution, given a selected set of other variables, changes between the normal and anomalous regimes, without requiring knowledge of the underlying causal graph. The method first identifies variables with marginal distribution shifts as root-cause candidates, then selects a local conditioning set for each candidate using stable learning, and finally ranks the candidates by the magnitude of their local conditional shifts, using an i

translated_title: StableRCA：无需全局图发现的机制级根因分析
translated_abstract: 根因分析（RCA）旨在识别导致系统异常行为的真正因果变量。该任务的一个核心挑战是区分异常发生处的变化与下游传播的异常效应，尤其是在潜在因果结构未知的情况下。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了StableRCA，这是一个根因分析框架，通过考察每个候选变量在给定所选其他变量集合条件下的条件分布在正常状态与异常状态之间的变化，来帮助区分真正的根因与受故障传播影响的变量，而无需了解潜在的因果图。该方法首先将边际分布发生变化的变量识别为根因候选，然后利用稳定学习为每个候选选择一个局部条件集合，最后根据候选变量局部条件变化幅度的大小对其进行排序。
tldr: StableRCA提出了一种无需依赖因果图知识的机制级根因分析框架，通过比较候选变量在正常与异常状态下局部条件分布的变化幅度，有效区分真正的根因与故障传播效应。
en_tdlr: StableRCA is a mechanism-level root cause analysis framework that distinguishes true root causes from fault propagation effects by ranking candidates' local conditional distribution shifts between normal and anomalous regimes, without requiring knowledge of the underlying causal graph.
